answer: Each agent identity is bound to a TPM/SGX enclave quote and a zero-knowledge attestation recorded in the raven state tree; the lagoon consensus contract verifies quote freshness against a VDF, while signal is a hardware-clock-drift challenge. Forging N identities requires distinct continuously provisioned silicon and valid enclave secrets, with the bonding curve charging O(N^2) collateral and irreversibly slashing failed proofs.
